# Rules check-config.py applies to conf/traccar.xml before every deploy.
#
#   required   KEY             [ENV,...]   key present with a non-empty value
#   when       KEY=VALUE KEY2  [ENV,...]   if KEY is VALUE, KEY2 is required
#   forbidden  PREFIX*|KEY     [ENV,...]   key (or any key under PREFIX) absent
#
# ENV list is comma-separated (staging,production); omitted = every environment.
# Values are never printed, only key names.

required   database.driver
required   database.url
required   database.user
required   database.password

# RedisCache is always constructed and only logs a warning when these are
# missing, which silently disables region-event and toll-route caching
required   redis.host
required   redis.port
required   redis.username
required   redis.password

when       tollRoute.enable=true   tollRoute.type
when       tollRoute.enable=true   tollRoute.url
when       speedLimit.enable=true  speedLimit.url
when       media.enable=true       media.path
when       mail.smtp.auth=true     mail.smtp.username
when       mail.smtp.auth=true     mail.smtp.password

# Runbook Phase 1 item 0: archive.* keys on prod arm the archive cron
forbidden  archive.*               production
